site.title: zerodep
site.intro: A collection of focused npm packages with zero (or near-zero) runtime dependencies, plus the BPMN engine ecosystem they grew up around. Open source, MIT, maintained by Pål Edman.
site.seoTitle: zerodep — small JavaScript packages and the bpmn-engine ecosystem
site.seoDescription: Open-source npm packages with zero runtime dependencies, plus bpmn-engine — the JavaScript BPMN 2.0 execution engine for Node.js. Includes DMN decision evaluation, ISO 8601 parsing, structured logging, workflow middleware, and testing utilities.

groups.title: zerodep packages
groups.description: Standalone utilities published under the zerodep org. Each one solves a single problem and ships without runtime dependencies wherever possible.

projects.name: @0dep/piso
projects.description: ISO 8601 parser for intervals, durations, dates, and week numbers. Converts to milliseconds, ISO strings, and Date objects with full standard coverage.

projects.name: @0dep/pino-applicationinsights
projects.description: Pino logger transport that forwards structured logs to Azure Application Insights. Compatible with both v2 and v3 of the Application Insights SDK.

projects.name: ocrgenerator
projects.description: Swedish invoice number (OCR/fakturanummer) generator and validator. Supports Bankgirot and Plusgirot reference formats with modulus-10 (Luhn) check digits.

projects.name: texample
projects.description: Run the JavaScript code blocks in your README as live tests. Keeps documentation honest by failing CI when an example breaks.

groups.title: BPMN engine ecosystem
groups.description: The BPMN 2.0 engine and its building blocks. Used together to execute, extend, and serialize workflow processes in JavaScript and TypeScript.

link.label: Run a diagram in your browser

projects.name: bpmn-engine
projects.description: BPMN 2.0 execution engine for Node.js and the browser. Runs business processes defined in standard BPMN XML, with TypeScript types, ESM/CJS support, and granular debug logging.

projects.name: bpmn-middleware
projects.description: Express middleware that runs the BPMN engine inside a Node.js HTTP application. Handles process state, call activities, and workflow orchestration over REST.

projects.name: bpmn-elements
projects.description: Executable workflow elements that implement the BPMN 2.0 specification. The building blocks behind bpmn-engine, usable on their own to assemble custom runtimes.

projects.name: dmn-elements
projects.description: Executable DMN 1.3 decision elements: parse decision requirement graphs and evaluate decision tables and boxed expressions with FEEL. The decision-side sibling of bpmn-elements.

projects.name: smqp
projects.description: Synchronous in-process message broker with exchanges, queues, topics, and ack/nack semantics. Underpins bpmn-engine and bpmn-elements without pulling in a real broker dependency.

projects.name: moddle-context-serializer
projects.description: Serialize bpmn-moddle contexts to JSON for storage and process state recovery. Pairs with bpmn-engine to persist long-running workflows.

projects.name: @0dep/bpmn-extensions
projects.description: Flow extensions for bpmn-elements: FEEL expressions and the Zeebe-namespace BPMN extension elements for Camunda 8 style workflows.

projects.name: @onify/flow-extensions
projects.description: Onify Flow extensions for bpmn-engine. Adds the service tasks, listeners, and Camunda-style behaviours used by the Onify automation platform.

groups.title: Worth a look
groups.description: Packages I've contributed to or recommend — same dependency-light spirit, different repos.

projects.name: @aller/express-swagger
projects.description: Adds a Swagger / OpenAPI v3 specification to an Express application, derived automatically from the types of the routes registered on the app.

projects.name: @aller/pino-gcp-transport
projects.description: Pino transport that emits Google Cloud structured logs to stdout. Drop-in for services running on GKE, Cloud Run, or anywhere GCP scrapes JSON logs.

projects.name: @aller/google-cloud-secret
projects.description: Concurrency-safe updates of Google Cloud Secret Manager secrets using the secret etag as an optimistic lock, plus a secrets cache and a fake Secret Manager gRPC server for tests.

projects.name: @onify/fake-amqplib
projects.description: In-memory fake of the amqplib RabbitMQ client for unit tests. Drop-in API-compatible replacement so tests don't need a live broker.

projects.name: chronokinesis
projects.description: Time-travel for testing time-dependent code. Freeze, travel, and reset the clock — works with Date, hrtime, performance, and timezones.

projects.name: unnecessary
projects.description: Lightweight coverage for huge projects: finds files never required or imported during testing by comparing the project tree with the require cache and V8 coverage. Ships a CLI, mocha root hooks, and node:test and lab reporters.
